SELECT ac.id, ac.app_number, ac.app_price, ac.vault, ac.application_id,
ad.tax_price, ad.goods_amount, ad.freight, ad.pay_date, ad.arrive_date, ad.invoice_date, ad.warranty_date, ad.supplier_name, ad.supplier_address, ad.contact_person, ad.contact_tel, ad.fax, ad.tax_no, ad.email, ad.order_no, ad.expect_info,
COALESCE(p.name, fp.fin_product_name) AS productName, COALESCE(p.description, fp.fin_description, '') AS model, COALESCE(p.unit, fp.unit, '') AS unit, COALESCE(p.material_number, fp.fin_material_number, '') AS materialNumber, IFNULL(att.brand, '') AS brand, IFNULL(att.package, '') AS package,
u.name AS applyUserName
FROM application_content ac
LEFT JOIN application_form af ON ac.application_id = af.id LEFT JOIN user u ON af.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN application_detail ad ON ac.id = ad.application_content_id LEFT JOIN product p ON ac.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN fin_product fp ON ac.fin_product_id = fp.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT productId AS id, 0 AS vault, MAX(CASE WHEN name='品牌' THEN content END) AS brand, MAX(CASE WHEN name='封装' THEN content END) AS package FROM attribute_content LEFT JOIN attribute_name ON attribute_content.parentId = attribute_name.id WHERE name IN ('品牌','封装') GROUP BY productId, vault
UNION ALL
SELECT fin_product_id AS id, 1 AS vault, MAX(CASE WHEN fin_att_name='品牌' THEN fin_att_content END) AS brand, MAX(CASE WHEN fin_att_name='封装' THEN fin_att_content END) AS package FROM fin_attribute_content LEFT JOIN fin_attribute_name ON fin_attribute_content.fin_att_name_id = fin_attribute_name.id WHERE fin_att_name IN ('品牌','封装') GROUP BY fin_product_id ) att ON ( (ac.product_id = att.id AND ac.vault = att.vault) OR (ac.fin_product_id = att.id AND att.vault = 1) )
WHERE af.sort = 2 and af.circulation_boss = 1
LIMIT #{start},#{pageSize}
